subtitle.en: THE LAB  ·  THE CODE LAB  ·  CHALLENGES

why.zh: 从真实页面录下的操作演示：逐步构造 L、求 Fiedler 排序、沿数轴扫描四个切点，对照原作的三位小数向量，看断开的图怎样报警、改一条边权怎样让切点移动，再在浏览器里写完 laplacian()、sweep() 和 count_bipartitions() 并通过全部检查。
why.en: Recorded from the real page: building L step by step, getting the Fiedler order, sweeping the four cut points along the number line, comparing the original's three-decimal vector, seeing how a disconnected graph raises a warning and how changing one weight moves the cut, then writing laplacian(), sweep() and count_bipartitions() in the browser and passing every check.
